id: title:dmarticus:real speech to text for composer dictation

review.posthog_relevance: Adds speech recognition capability and session management, but implementation is incomplete.
review.reason: The chunk P1.F2.H1 adds the ExpoSpeechRecognitionModule and related event handling, while P1.F3.H3 adds session-ID guards and permission checks. However, the chunk explicitly states that the implementation of stop, cancel, and start methods is missing, and P1.F3.H3 is a single hunk without established relationship to other changes. This makes it impossible to assess the full scope,
review.uncertainty: The chunk does not include the complete implementation of the added functionality. P1.F3.H3 adds the Dictation and Heard interfaces and the useDictation hook, but the actual implementation of stop, cancel, and start methods is missing. P1.F1.H4 and P1.F1.H5 show the Composer component being updated to use the new stop and editText, but P1.F3.H2 does not show the implementation.
